scope: Controlled finite programs only; not empirical calibration for Java/JDBC applications
label: 1 iff at least one allowed state has different complete contractual observations after deletion; otherwise 0 by exhaustive comparison in this finite domain
split: leave one entire mechanism family out; no random candidate split
fit: joint Boolean feature cells with fixed Beta(1,1)-style smoothing of family-normalized counts; each training family has total weight one; unseen cells use smoothed training prevalence
selection: Report Brier and log loss; no promotion unless both beat both baselines; real-domain deployment is excluded regardless
stop: one fixed suite and grouped evaluation, no tuning after outcomes; preserve failures and old risk parameters
